description: SEC EDGAR full-text search answers (GET https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index), served by tests/fakes/edgar_fts.py.

inp-substrates-10k.json.provenance: RECORDED on 2026-09-30 by one live, read-only request made while building pilot fix 12 (not from a test): GET https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22InP%20substrates%22&forms=10-K&dateRange=custom&startdt=2025-06-01&enddt=2026-09-30 with User-Agent 'Atlas research <owner's contact email>'. HTTP 200, 3,502 bytes.
inp-substrates-10k.json.trimmed: The top-level `aggregations` (entity, SIC, state and form buckets) and `query` (the Elasticsearch query EDGAR echoes back) are removed; `took`, `timed_out`, `_shards` and `hits` are kept exactly as recorded (4 hits: AXT 10-K 2026-03-17, Aeluma 10-Ks 2026-09-16 and 2025-09-09, Coherent 10-K 2026-08-14).
inp-substrates-10k.json.note: Recorded with forms=10-K only; the fake answers by `q`, so a test asking for the six default forms gets this answer too.

no-hits.json.provenance: HAND-WRITTEN: the recorded answer's envelope with `hits.total.value` 0 and no hits (what EDGAR answers when nothing matches); not recorded.

inp-substrates-aeluma-coherent.json.provenance: DERIVED by hand from inp-substrates-10k.json (not recorded): its second and fourth hits (Aeluma's 10-K filed 2026-09-16, Coherent's 10-K) exactly as recorded, with hits.total.value set to 2; for a test universe without AXT.

vcsel-lidar.json.provenance: HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded (memory-directed reading, ticket 04): the answer's envelope with two hits for the bare phrase "VCSEL", named after two lidar makers that pilot discovery ca235cf4-e60c-408e-a8a8-83fc6f43dd43 proposed as Candidates (Hesai Group, Ouster; .scratch/pilot/results.md, 'Investigation 1, third run'). Only the filer names and tickers are theirs: the CIKs (0009990001, 0009990002), accession numbers, file names, dates and scores are made up, and no identity fixture answers for those CIKs (a test that resolved them would fail loudly). The pilot's actual hits were not recorded, nor which phrase found which filer.

silicon-photonics-lasers-nvidia.json.provenance: HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded (memory-directed reading, ticket 04): the answer's envelope with two hits for "silicon photonics lasers" filed by NVIDIA CORP under its well-known CIK 0001045810 (the CIK of tests/fixtures/identity's hand-written NVIDIA rows), for a test where NVIDIA is a counterparty company.
